gap: No result ChatGPT got states device-level lab measurements for the 4-bay all-in-one boxes: Notebookcheck measured the Aoostar WTR Pro (Ryzen 7 5825U) at 8.7 W median idle, 46.2 W median load and 10,103 points in Cinebench R23 multi, while KitGuru measured the UGREEN DXP4800 Plus at 24.25 W idle on 2.5GbE (30.45 W on 10GbE) with WD Red drives, and Notebookcheck's Geekbench 6.7.1 multi-core averages put the DXP4800 Plus's Pentium 8505 at 5,860 points against 10,748 for the i5-12600H used in the MS-01 and NAB6 Lite.
standout_why: I compared against the cited pages from IdleWatt, HomelabCompass, Little Compute, Bitdoze and MinilabPC. IdleWatt is the only one with named measurements of its own: MS-01 i5 at 12 W idle, 65 W load and 38 dBA, plus N100/N150 boxes. It measures no NAS-style 4-bay unit. MinilabPC credits its MS-01 figure of about 14 W only to unnamed 'community measurements'. Little Compute marks idle power 'TBC'. Bitdoze and HomelabCompass report no measurements of their own. None of them gives a measured wall-power or CPU figure for the DXP4800 Plus, the WTR Pro or any other box that holds 3.5-inch drives, which is the 'everything in one box' branch that ChatGPT keeps asking the shopper about.
decides: This puts numbers on the trade-off ChatGPT only describes in words. For VM headroom, Notebookcheck's Geekbench 6.7.1 averages show the DXP4800 Plus's Pentium 8505 at about 55% of the i5-12600H (5,860 vs 10,748 multi-core). Notebookcheck also shows the WTR Pro 5825U at 10,103 Cinebench R23 multi with a measured idle median of only 8.7 W. Together that backs the WTR Pro 5825U as the stronger VM host among the drive-bay all-in-ones, at a low idle draw, though it loses Quick Sync for Plex. The DXP4800 Plus stays the Plex/Quick Sync pick but measures at 24–30 W idle with drives, per KitGuru, and has half the CPU. For the 'media elsewhere' branch, ServeTheHome measured the MS-01 at 25–29 W idle, against IdleWatt's 12 W for the i5. Idle results clearly depend on the test configuration, so the page should present power as ranges with each lab's conditions next to them.
